name: Daway Scan Sessions - Dev
description:
Environment for testing the Scan Sessions (phone barcode scanner) endpoints.

[SECURITY] device_token and pairing_token are populated at RUNTIME by the post-response scripts - they are NOT hardcoded here. pairing_token is the 'token' query param extracted from pairing_url (run 02 captures pairing_url; copy its ?token= value into pairing_token once, manually, the first time).

Variables:
  base_url           - API origin (no trailing slash)
  pharmacy_custom_id - the pharmacy CUSTOM id (pharmacies.pharmacy_custom_id), NOT the numeric id
  pharmacy_password  - credential (see 5/min per IP + 5/min per account throttle on /login/pharmacy)
  pharmacy_token     - Bearer; set by 01 login response
  session_id         - uuid; set by 02 create response
  pairing_url        - daway://pair?sid=...&token=...; set by 02 (use ONCE to seed pairing_token, then discard)
  pairing_token      - extracted from pairing_url ?token=; sent as X-Scan-Token to pair
  pairing_qr_svg     - server-rendered QR SVG from 02; display only
  pairing_code       - 8-char fallback code from 02
  pending_device_name - filled when 05 returns 409 (see GET /{id} .pending_device.name)
  device_token       - issued ONCE by pair; sent as X-Device-Token to barcode. Store securely!
